title: From Local Prediction Error to Final Outputs: A Theory of Expert Sharing in Multi-Step Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.17879v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can share experts across layers or computational steps, pooling training information from different contexts. This can reduce local prediction error, but multi-step systems are ultimately evaluated by their final outputs. We study when these local gains survive composition. In specified linear regression models, we derive exact sharing and merging criteria by balancing variance savings against bias from sharing across roles with different target behavior. Under a common fixed linear propagation map, we characterize expected squared final-output risk, retaining error directions and correlations. We construct cases where sharing lowers average local error yet increases final-output error. Within this setting, we also identify when orthogonal full pooling with isotropic noise preserves every local improvement at the final output. For general routed computations, we derive conditional end-to-end error bounds

translated_title: 从局部预测误差到最终输出：多步推理中的专家共享理论
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型可以在层间或计算步骤间共享专家，汇集来自不同上下文的训练信息。这可以降低局部预测误差，但多步系统最终是以其最终输出来评估的。我们研究了这些局部收益何时能在复合过程中得以保留。在指定的线性回归模型中，我们通过权衡方差节省与跨不同目标行为的角色共享所带来的偏差，推导出精确的共享与合并准则。在共同固定线性传播映射下，我们刻画了期望平方最终输出风险，并保留了误差方向和相关性。我们构造了共享降低平均局部误差却增加最终输出误差的案例。在此设定下，我们还识别了带各向同性噪声的正交完全池化在何种条件下能在最终输出处保留所有局部改进。对于一般的路由计算，我们推导出条件端到端误差界。
tldr: 该论文建立了多步推理中专家共享的理论框架，通过权衡方差节省与偏差推导出共享何时有效的精确准则，并揭示了一个关键现象：共享专家可能降低局部预测误差却反而增大最终输出误差。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theory of expert sharing in multi-step reasoning MoE models, deriving exact criteria for when local prediction-error gains survive composition, and showing that sharing can lower average local error yet increase final-output error.
